faqs.q: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.a: Most weekend events book 6–12 months out. Weekday meetings often book 2–6 weeks ahead. Holiday parties: book by early fall.

faqs.q: Can we bring our own cake or outside dessert?
faqs.a: Yes — outside cakes and desserts are welcome with a small cutting and plating fee.
